title: Feature Request - compatibility with passage
line: The Pass widget now also shows and copies passwords from a passage store, next to the pass ones.
explanation: The Pass widget only scanned ~/.password-store for .gpg files and decrypted them itself with GpgME, so people who use passage (the age based fork of pass, store in ~/.passage/store or $PASSAGE_DIR) got an empty list. The model now also scans the passage store for .age files and merges it into the same tree (folders with the same name are shown once). Selecting a passage entry runs `passage show <name>`, so passage keeps handling identities, plugins and PASSAGE_AGE; its error text is shown if decryption fails. OTP (otpauth:// lines) works the same way for both stores.

commits.message:
plugin: support passage stores alongside pass

The applet only read .gpg files from the pass store, so passage users
(the age based fork of pass) saw an empty list. Also list the .age files
of the passage store and decrypt them by running passage show.

BUG: 459051
